sections.text: On iPhone: 1. Open the Messages app. 2. If the message is not yet opened: swipe left on the message, tap the Delete button, then tap 'Delete and Report Spam.' You can't report a message after you've replied to it. For SMS, MMS, or RCS spam, if you don't see the option, contact your carrier. Reporting doesn't stop the sender, so block them separately if needed.

On Android: 1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Google Messages. 2. Touch and hold the conversation you want to report. 3. Tap 'Block,' then 'Report spam,' then 'OK.' Reporting is optional. You can block a number without reporting it to Google. Reporting sends the spammer's phone number and their last 10 incoming messages to Google.
